body:
Follow-ups from the integrated review of the ledger-guests feature (T-364..T-368) before 4.0.0, found by a code review of v3.7.0..main:

- Web chooser: claiming a locked guest said "Failed to save" instead of "{name}: amounts locked" (Android said it right).
- Both clients: the Guests section numbered a departed claimant over the entries in sync/DAO order, not the ledger's order, so "claimed by Former member N" could disagree with every other screen (T-197).
- Android: an inline rename closed the field before the server answered, losing the draft on refusal or offline; the web keeps it open.
- Android: Remove was offered only for unclaimed guests, the web for all (the server permits removing a claimed guest no live entry names); and the Guests section repeated the page's voted-to-close note.
- Hygiene: the web ledger page folded every entry three times per render; Android rebuilt the ledger Roster on every access and the overview derived the roster by hand; the server decoded every live entry to find a guest's — now prefiltered with instr().
title: Ledger guests: review follow-ups before 4.0.0 — chooser wording, former numbering, rename draft, Remove parity, folds
